list.name: server
list.label: Server
list.query: SELECT name AS __text, server_id AS __value FROM config.config_monitored_servers WHERE is_enabled ORDER BY name
list.description: Monitored SQL Server instance, from Darling's fleet registry.

targets.rawSql:
WITH latest AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ON (database_name, file_name)
        database_name, file_name, file_type_desc, total_size_mb
    FROM collect.v_database_size_stats
    WHERE server_id IN (${server:csv})
    ORDER BY database_name, file_name, collection_time DESC
)
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(total_size_mb), 0) AS v
FROM latest
WHERE upper(file_type_desc) <> 'LOG'

SELECT CASE WHEN SUM(delta_reads + delta_writes) > 0
    THEN SUM(delta_stall_read_ms + delta_stall_write_ms)::double precision
         / SUM(delta_reads + delta_writes)
    ELSE 0 END AS v
FROM collect.v_file_io_stats
WHERE collection_time >= (now() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') - INTERVAL '1 hour' AND server_id IN (${server:csv})

SELECT CASE WHEN (total_reserved_mb + unallocated_mb) > 0
    THEN total_reserved_mb::double precision / (total_reserved_mb + unallocated_mb) * 100.0
    ELSE 0 END AS v
FROM collect.v_tempdb_stats
WHERE server_id IN (${server:csv})
ORDER BY collection_time DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT database_name || '.' || file_name || ' - ' || to_char(round((avg_latency_ms)::numeric, 1), 'FM999999990.0') || ' ms' AS v
FROM (
    SELECT database_name, file_name,
        CASE WHEN SUM(delta_reads + delta_writes) > 0
            THEN SUM(delta_stall_read_ms + delta_stall_write_ms)::double precision
                 / SUM(delta_reads + delta_writes)
            ELSE 0 END AS avg_latency_ms
    FROM collect.v_file_io_stats
    WHERE collection_time >= (now() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') - INTERVAL '1 hour' AND server_id IN (${server:csv})
    GROUP BY database_name, file_name
) AS f
ORDER BY avg_latency_ms DESC
LIMIT 1

WITH top_files AS (

    SELECT f.server_id, f.database_name, f.file_name
    FROM collect.v_file_io_stats AS f
    WHERE $__timeFilter(f.collection_time)
      AND f.server_id IN (${server:csv})
      AND (f.delta_reads > 0 OR f.delta_writes > 0)
    GROUP BY f.server_id, f.database_name, f.file_name
    ORDER BY SUM(f.delta_reads + f.delta_writes) DESC
    LIMIT 10

)
SELECT
    f.collection_time AS time,
    f.database_name || '.' || f.file_name || s.suffix AS metric,
    s.value AS value
FROM collect.v_file_io_stats AS f
JOIN top_files AS tf
  ON tf.server_id = f.server_id
 AND tf.database_name = f.database_name
 AND tf.file_name = f.file_name
CROSS JOIN LATERAL (VALUES
    ('', CASE WHEN f.delta_reads > 0
              THEN f.delta_stall_read_ms::double precision / f.delta_reads
              ELSE 0 END),
    (' (queued)', CASE WHEN f.delta_reads > 0
                       THEN COALESCE(f.delta_stall_queued_read_ms, 0)::double precision / f.delta_reads
                       ELSE 0 END)
) AS s(suffix, value)
WHERE $__timeFilter(f.collection_time)
  AND f.server_id IN (${server:csv})
ORDER BY 1

WITH top_files AS (

    SELECT f.server_id, f.database_name, f.file_name
    FROM collect.v_file_io_stats AS f
    WHERE $__timeFilter(f.collection_time)
      AND f.server_id IN (${server:csv})
      AND (f.delta_reads > 0 OR f.delta_writes > 0)
    GROUP BY f.server_id, f.database_name, f.file_name
    ORDER BY SUM(f.delta_reads + f.delta_writes) DESC
    LIMIT 10

)
SELECT
    f.collection_time AS time,
    f.database_name || '.' || f.file_name || s.suffix AS metric,
    s.value AS value
FROM collect.v_file_io_stats AS f
JOIN top_files AS tf
  ON tf.server_id = f.server_id
 AND tf.database_name = f.database_name
 AND tf.file_name = f.file_name
CROSS JOIN LATERAL (VALUES
    ('', CASE WHEN f.delta_writes > 0
              THEN f.delta_stall_write_ms::double precision / f.delta_writes
              ELSE 0 END),
    (' (queued)', CASE WHEN f.delta_writes > 0
                       THEN COALESCE(f.delta_stall_queued_write_ms, 0)::double precision / f.delta_writes
                       ELSE 0 END)
) AS s(suffix, value)
WHERE $__timeFilter(f.collection_time)
  AND f.server_id IN (${server:csv})
ORDER BY 1

WITH top_files AS (

    SELECT f.server_id, f.database_name, f.file_name
    FROM collect.v_file_io_stats AS f
    WHERE $__timeFilter(f.collection_time)
      AND f.server_id IN (${server:csv})
      AND (f.delta_read_bytes > 0 OR f.delta_write_bytes > 0)
    GROUP BY f.server_id, f.database_name, f.file_name
    ORDER BY SUM(f.delta_read_bytes + f.delta_write_bytes) DESC
    LIMIT 10

),
windowed AS (
    SELECT
        f.collection_time,
        f.database_name || '.' || f.file_name AS file_label,
        f.delta_read_bytes AS moved_bytes,
        EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (f.collection_time - LAG(f.collection_time) OVER (
            PARTITION BY f.server_id, f.database_name, f.file_name
            ORDER BY f.collection_time))) AS interval_seconds
    FROM collect.v_file_io_stats AS f
    JOIN top_files AS tf
      ON tf.server_id = f.server_id
     AND tf.database_name = f.database_name
     AND tf.file_name = f.file_name
    WHERE $__timeFilter(f.collection_time)
      AND f.server_id IN (${server:csv})
)
SELECT
    collection_time AS time,
    file_label AS metric,
    moved_bytes::double precision / interval_seconds / 1048576.0 AS value
FROM windowed
WHERE interval_seconds > 0
ORDER BY 1

WITH top_files AS (

    SELECT f.server_id, f.database_name, f.file_name
    FROM collect.v_file_io_stats AS f
    WHERE $__timeFilter(f.collection_time)
      AND f.server_id IN (${server:csv})
      AND (f.delta_read_bytes > 0 OR f.delta_write_bytes > 0)
    GROUP BY f.server_id, f.database_name, f.file_name
    ORDER BY SUM(f.delta_read_bytes + f.delta_write_bytes) DESC
    LIMIT 10

),
windowed AS (
    SELECT
        f.collection_time,
        f.database_name || '.' || f.file_name AS file_label,
        f.delta_write_bytes AS moved_bytes,
        EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (f.collection_time - LAG(f.collection_time) OVER (
            PARTITION BY f.server_id, f.database_name, f.file_name
            ORDER BY f.collection_time))) AS interval_seconds
    FROM collect.v_file_io_stats AS f
    JOIN top_files AS tf
      ON tf.server_id = f.server_id
     AND tf.database_name = f.database_name
     AND tf.file_name = f.file_name
    WHERE $__timeFilter(f.collection_time)
      AND f.server_id IN (${server:csv})
)
SELECT
    collection_time AS time,
    file_label AS metric,
    moved_bytes::double precision / interval_seconds / 1048576.0 AS value
FROM windowed
WHERE interval_seconds > 0
ORDER BY 1

SELECT
    td.collection_time AS time,
    s.series AS metric,
    s.value AS value
FROM collect.v_tempdb_stats AS td
CROSS JOIN LATERAL (VALUES
    ('User Objects', td.user_object_reserved_mb),
    ('Internal Objects', td.internal_object_reserved_mb),
    ('Version Store', td.version_store_reserved_mb)
) AS s(series, value)
WHERE $__timeFilter(td.collection_time)
  AND td.server_id IN (${server:csv})
ORDER BY 1

SELECT
    td.collection_time AS time,
    'Allocated Size' AS metric,
    td.total_reserved_mb + td.unallocated_mb AS value
FROM collect.v_tempdb_stats AS td
WHERE $__timeFilter(td.collection_time)
  AND td.server_id IN (${server:csv})
ORDER BY 1

SELECT
    f.collection_time AS time,
    f.file_name || s.suffix AS metric,
    s.value AS value
FROM collect.v_file_io_stats AS f
CROSS JOIN LATERAL (VALUES
    (' read', CASE WHEN f.delta_reads > 0
                   THEN f.delta_stall_read_ms::double precision / f.delta_reads
                   ELSE 0 END),
    (' write', CASE WHEN f.delta_writes > 0
                    THEN f.delta_stall_write_ms::double precision / f.delta_writes
                    ELSE 0 END)
) AS s(suffix, value)
WHERE $__timeFilter(f.collection_time)
  AND f.server_id IN (${server:csv})
  AND f.database_name = 'tempdb'
ORDER BY 1
